title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez are standout performers in the Patriots' training camp, solidifying their roles as key players.
Kyle Williams and Lan Larison are facing challenges in camp, with reduced reps affecting their depth chart standings.
Marcus Bryant is showing promise at left tackle, stepping in for Will Campbell during his absence from drills.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias, batting .326 with 12 RBI, impresses at Triple-A Worcester after recent call-up.
With Boston players recovering from injuries, Arias could be considered for a late-season MLB debut.
Craig Breslow emphasizes Arias' development in Triple-A, though Sox monitor MLB roster needs.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police ask for public's help identifying a suspect in a Jamaica Plain apartment break-in.
Incident occurred on Heath Street early Aug. 5, when the suspect entered through a window.
Suspect described as Black, late teens or early 20s, slim build, short hair, wearing a white t-shirt.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: John Paul advises a reader with a 2023 Ford Maverick on unusually early front sway bar link failure at 22,000 miles.
The use of Torx-Plus fasteners in vehicles is due to their stronger, more precise fit for automated assembly.
For maintaining a car battery, John Paul recommends CTEK chargers or Deltran's Battery Tender for their reliability.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions about his trade to the Philadelphia 76ers after a decade with the Celtics.
Brown has not communicated with former Celtics teammate Jayson Tatum since the trade, but praised their championship win.
Brown remarked on the Sixers' title chances, emphasizing teamwork and cautioning against potential distractions affecting team dynamics.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a Boston school bus rollover near 1000 Harvard St. in Mattapan.
The rollover occurred shortly before 1:10 p.m.; victims were hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries.
Police are investigating the cause of the bus rollover; no children were on board.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during a two-minute drill, contributing to a challenging day for the quarterback.
Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle in place of Will Campbell, who was limited due to an arm brace.
Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas participated in first-team reps, progressing in his return to play plan.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown will close permanently on November 2 after 21 years of operation.
Owners Viola 'Chach' Briseño and Sharon Bowes cited personal reasons and operational challenges for closing the restaurant.
Chach Restaurant, known for its scratch-made upscale comfort food, has been a popular dining spot in Provincetown.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix's August 2026 lineup includes classics like 'Clueless' and 'The Irishman'.
New additions include Bo Burnham's 'Eighth Grade' and Bradley Cooper's 'Maestro'.
Genres covered range from drama and comedy to action and documentaries.

title: Navy says it can’t help recover wreckage of Gloucester fishing boat Lily Jean
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: The US Navy declined Gov. Healey's request to help recover the wreckage of the Lily Jean off Cape Ann.
The Navy stated the US Coast Guard and NTSB have necessary information to conclude their investigation into the sinking.
Senate Minority Leader Bruce Tarr expressed disappointment but vowed to continue efforts to recover information from the vessel.
